title: Raƙumin da Ya Raba Jini
intro: Ka yi tunanin ambaliyar ruwa mai yawa da ke tashi a kan ƙasar, wani jirgin ruwa yana shawagi a kan ruwa, kuma rai ɗaya ya bar a waje bisa ga zaɓi. An ɗaure shi da jini ga annabi amma ya rabu da imani, wannan mutumin ya fuskanci kira na ƙarshe don ya shigo jirgin yayin da ruwan ke ambaliya. Za ka iya gano asalin abin da ke bayan ƙin amincewa?
clues: Ni zuriyar ɗaya daga cikin manyan annabawan Allah ne, gidan imani da na zaɓa na tafi.
Na rayu ne a lokacin Babban Ambaliyar Ruwa, lokacin da rashin imani ya mamaye ƙasar kamar ruwa.
Na ƙi shiga Jirgin tare da muminai lokacin da mahaifina ya kira ni.
Na ce zan nemi mafaka a kan dutse domin kare ni daga ruwa.
An gaya min cewa babu abin da zai iya kare ni daga hukuncin Allah a wannan ranar sai rahama.
Raƙuman ruwa sun bi ni suka nutse, aka gaya wa mahaifina cewa ni ba na cikin iyalinsa masu adalci ba ne.

arabic: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌۭ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verse: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!" (11:45)
